regions.merged_text: Mrs. Mary Knapp. 58 of 3657 Concord enrolled as against diabetes and threatened blood-poison for one year ( Aug 4th) goes to Ford Hospital same day. Next morning inflamation was entirely gone from the leg. The one toe remaining somewhat swollen Doctors insist on opening said toe and at once infection starts again. To-day fear - in that the leg be lost. She is enrolled perpet- ually this a.m.

regions.merged_text: Baby Saved. Francis Amelia Girard, 2 in October, of 592 Notre Dame Ave, Grous Pt. was enrolled last Friday, just a week ago. The doctor claimed she had but three days to live: "Asadosis stomach". they claimed was the trouble - with liver and kidney - trouble and heart in bad condition, and head swolen till her eyes could not open. This evening she is brought to the Monastery with the rest of the family to thank God for her remarkable recovery. Deo Gr. Died (later entry)

regions.merged_text: Mrs. Anna Charboneau 22 of 14142 Detroit Manor, about to have oper- ation on stomach after 4 years sickness is enrolled July 4th 1926 next day opened door for doctor who came to tell her the operation would be next day. Instead of operation she and husband started on a 500 mile trip by 24 hours and was in perfect health - and is so ever since.
